description: Defines the RefreshRateStats class which encapsulates statistics about display refresh rates, including timing, power modes, and methods for collecting and reporting refresh rate durations.

classes.name: RefreshRateStats
classes.description: A class that tracks and reports statistics related to display refresh rates, including timing in different power modes and refresh rate switches.

methods.name: setPowerMode
methods.description: Sets the current power mode and flushes timing data if the mode changes.

methods.name: setRefreshRate
methods.description: Updates the current refresh rate and records a switch if the rate changes.

methods.name: getTotalTimes
methods.description: Returns a map of refresh rate modes to total time spent in each mode.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the collected refresh rate timing data into a string.

methods.name: flushTime
methods.description: Calculates and updates the time spent since the last call, updating total times based on current power mode.

methods.name: getDateFormatFromMs
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string of days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.
